title: Why am I being charged a fee on my Bronze Saver Account?
summary: Explains fee line items that may appear on a Bronze Saver Account: the monthly maintenance fee is $0.00, excess withdrawals over 12 per statement cycle cost $3.00 each, and paper statements may add a $3.00 paper statement fee for that cycle. It also tells how to confirm the fee type by reading the charge description and checking the posting date.
faqs: Why does my Bronze Saver statement show a maintenance fee if the monthly maintenance fee is $0.00?
What happens if I make more than 12 withdrawals in a statement cycle (and what is the $3.00 fee)?
How can I tell whether the charge on my statement is an “Excess withdrawal fee” or a “Paper statement fee”?
If I choose paper statements, what fee might appear and when?
How do I avoid excess withdrawal fees and the $3.00 paper statement fee?
